about.heading: Professional, Standards Compliant Website Development & Design
about.bio: Hello! I'm Richard, a freelance WordPress developer and designer based in the Philippines. I specialize in creating visually appealing and functional websites. I pride myself on doing things the right way, ensuring happy clients every time. Let's work together to bring your ideas to life!
about.subText:
After a website? I can take care of everything for you. From eye-catching design to make your website unique, to standards compliant code using the latest web technologies, to ensure your site looks beautiful in today's browsers.

I can also sort out your domain name and web hosting, and provide a content management system to allow you to easily keep your website content up-to-date.

services.title: Web Design
services.description: Crafting visually appealing and user-friendly websites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with a strong focus on responsive design and seamless user experience.

services.title: Web Development
services.description: Developing robust and dynamic web applications using WordPress, MySQL, PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, ensuring functionality, performance, and scalability.

services.title: Domain Registration
services.description: I offer quick and hassle-free domain registration services to help you secure the perfect web address for your business.

services.title: Web Hosting
services.description: I provide comprehensive web hosting setup and configuration services, ensuring your website is securely installed, optimized for performance, and ready to deliver a seamless user experience.

services.title: SEO
services.description: Enhancing website visibility and search engine rankings through keyword optimization, content strategy, and technical SEO best practices.

services.title: Virtual Assistant
services.description: Providing efficient administrative support, managing tasks, scheduling, and assisting with projects remotely, ensuring smooth operations and client satisfaction.
